blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara called for multi-sectoral security cooperation and proactive mental health support during a visit to Banga National High School on Saturday, following a fatal shooting inside the campus. Angara met with school officials, parents, local leaders, and police officers to coordinate emergency response efforts and assess security gaps. During his visit, the education chief inspected the campus, attended security debriefings, visited the wakes of the victims, and checked on hospitalized victims. Addressing the incident, Angara acknowledged that the Department of Education’s primary focus on academics leaves schools ill-equipped to handle violent events on their own. […]...
